role_context: ts.pv2.edu.owner, owner of education panel 5 (TSW-0005); shots_eot_ts73

pages.task: See what needs attention today (finished results, unassigned participants) and start an invitation
pages.summary: Good task-first structure (attention list, one primary action), but dark mode makes the KPI tiles, funnel table and workload unreadable, and the 'result ready' item leads to the invitation list instead of the result.

findings.issue: KPI tiles, funnel table body and workload cards render with a white background and light text in dark mode (contrast about 1.2:1); the numbers are unreadable.
findings.evidence: ts.pv2.edu.owner_my_workspaces_5_375_dark.png; report.txt row 37 'contrast span. 1.5|small. 1.5|th. 2.0|a. 1.2'; panel.scss:117 .tsp-stat, :144 .tsp-table, :145 .ts-table-wrap, :159 .tsp-table--cards tr all use background: var(--white)
findings.fix: See pattern PAT-1 (re-declare --white for dark, or use var(--color-surface)).

findings.issue: The attention item 'N نتیجهٔ آماده که هنوز باز نکرده‌اید' links to /invites?unseen=1. The counselor then has to open the invitation and click 'دیدن نتیجه': 3 clicks to reach a result, and the result's back link goes to a page that returns 500 (see P5-1).
findings.evidence: ts_panel/models/dashboard.py:129 url base + '/invites?unseen=1'; web_invites.xml rows link to /invites/<id> only
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks; ISO 9241-11 efficiency
findings.fix: When unseen == 1, link straight to result_url(); otherwise give the invites list a 'نتیجه' link in each row whose state is done (see P11-2).

findings.issue: The plural noun follows a number: '۳ شرکت‌کنندگان بدون کارشناس مسئول', '۱ دعوت‌های همکار در انتظار پذیرش'. Persian uses the singular after a numeral.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations; Persian conventions
findings.fix: Labels in dashboard.py: 'شرکت‌کننده بدون کارشناس مسئول', 'دعوت همکار در انتظار پذیرش', 'نتیجهٔ آماده‌ای که هنوز باز نکرده‌اید'.

findings.issue: In the setup checklist, completed steps differ from open ones only by colour: open steps are purple links, completed steps are black text. '(انجام شد)' exists only for screen readers. Sighted users cannot tell which steps are done.
findings.evidence: 375/1280 png 'گام‌های راه‌اندازی'; text '(انجام شد)' visually hidden
findings.fix: Show a check icon plus the visible word 'انجام شد' (or strike-through with an icon) on done items; put the open items first.

findings.issue: The numbers contradict each other: the KPI tile says 'پذیرفته‌شده ۱' (cumulative) while the funnel row says 'پذیرفته ۰' (current state). Neither label says which kind of count it is.
findings.fix: Name the funnel 'وضعیت فعلی دعوت‌ها' and the tiles 'در این دوره (تجمعی)'. Or make the tiles use the same state counts.

findings.issue: Six KPI tiles in a five-column grid leave 'مصرف این دوره' orphaned on a second row.
findings.fix: Use grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px,1fr)) with 3 columns at this width. Or move usage into the attention/side area.

pages.task: Same as the dashboard (alias)
pages.summary: Redirects to /my/workspaces/5 (FINAL differs) and serves the identical dashboard; the redirect is harmless but there are two URLs for one page.

findings.issue: /home 302-redirects to /my/workspaces/5. This is expected, but the menu, notifications and help should all use one canonical URL.
findings.fix: Keep the redirect and use only /my/workspaces/<id> in links.

findings.issue: Inherits the dark-mode white tiles and tables of P1-1.
findings.fix: PAT-1

pages.task: Find a participant, see who finished, open their result, assign a counselor, add people
pages.summary: Powerful list (filters, bulk actions), but the intro sends users to a legacy page, rows give no direct path to a finished result or to inviting, every name leads to a 500 page, and dark mode cards are unreadable.

findings.issue: Every participant name links to /clients/<id>, which returns 500. The list is a dead end for the counselor's main task (open a person, then a result).
findings.evidence: report.txt rows 131-132; see P5-1 for the cause
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the task; ISO/IEC 25010 operability
findings.fix: Fix P5-1.

findings.issue: The header text says new invitations are made from «دعوت و فهرست (نسخهٔ قبلی)», which is not in the menu and contradicts the 'دعوت‌ها' menu item and the 'دعوت تازه' wizard. The empty state says the same.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness, conformity with expectations; ISO 9241-112 consistency
findings.fix: Replace with 'افرادی که در این پنل ثبت یا دعوت شده‌اند.' and an empty-state with two actions: 'شرکت‌کنندهٔ جدید' and a link to '/invites/new?fresh=1' ('دعوت به سنجه').

findings.issue: A row with تکمیل‌شده ۱ offers no 'نتیجه' link, and no row offers 'دعوت به سنجه'. The counselor must open the person page (broken) or go through the invitations list.
findings.evidence: page text lines 57-66; png cards show only name + data
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks; ISO 9241-11 efficiency
findings.fix: Add an actions cell: 'نتیجه' (latest done attempt, result_url) when completed > 0, and 'دعوت' -> /invites/new?client=<id>.

findings.issue: The filter chips overflow horizontally with no scroll cue: 'بایگانی‌شده', 'درخواست واگذاری' and 'مراجعان باز من' are off-screen. The search placeholder is cut ('...یا ایه').
findings.fix: Let .tsp-chips wrap on phone, or add an end fade mask. Shorten the placeholder to 'نام، شناسه یا موبایل'.

findings.issue: The bulk-action panel always shows three selects (کار, کارشناس, گروه) even when no row is selected and whatever action is chosen. On a phone it is a long, confusing form.
findings.fix: Hide the bulk bar until a checkbox is ticked (show 'N انتخاب‌شده'). Show only the select that matches the chosen action (aria-expanded JS, works without JS by showing all).

findings.issue: The group filter needs a separate 'اعمال' button while the chips apply instantly. Two different filter behaviours sit on one row.
findings.fix: Keep the button for no-JS, but submit on change with JS. Or turn groups into a chip row as well.

findings.issue: Cards (tsp-table--cards tr) are white with light text in dark mode.
findings.fix: PAT-1

pages.task: Register a student by hand, then invite them
pages.summary: Clear labelled form, but saving lands on the broken person page, guardian fields always show, there is no cancel and no 'save and invite' path, and the back arrow points the wrong way.

findings.issue: After 'ذخیره' the controller redirects to /clients/<new id>, which returns 500 (P5-1). The user sees an English error right after a successful save and cannot tell whether the record was created.
findings.fix: Fix P5-1.

findings.issue: The back link is '← بازگشت'. In RTL a left arrow means forward. The same panel uses '→' elsewhere (a/5, workspaces/new).
findings.fix: Use '→ شرکت‌کنندگان' (or the shared ts_website.icon arrow-right). See PAT-3.

findings.issue: The guardian block (نام، موبایل، نسبت) always shows, even when گروه سنی is بزرگسال. The form is twice as long as needed on a phone.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-143 field grouping, defaults; ISO 9241-110 suitability
findings.fix: Show the fieldset only when age_group == 'minor' (button/aria-expanded or a :has() rule; no-JS fallback shows it).

findings.issue: The only button is 'ذخیره': no 'انصراف', and no 'ثبت و دعوت به سنجه' even though inviting is the next task in almost every case. The button label does not name the outcome.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 controllability, suitability; GOV.UK button labels
findings.fix: Primary 'ثبت شرکت‌کننده'; secondary submit name=then value=invite 'ثبت و دعوت' that redirects to /invites/new?client=<id>; quiet link 'انصراف' to the list.

findings.issue: For the owner, کارشناس مسئول defaults to 'بدون کارشناس', so every hand-added person goes to the unassigned queue. That is how the dashboard reaches '۳ بدون کارشناس'.
findings.fix: Pre-select the creating member when they hold a responsible role, and keep 'بدون کارشناس' as an option.

pages.task: See one participant: details, responsible counselor, groups, assessments and results
pages.summary: The person page crashes with 500 for anyone who has a completed assessment, which breaks the central hub of the panel (also reached from notifications, the result page, invite pages and form saves).

findings.issue: HTTP 500 for both owner and counselor. The template uses an undefined variable `client`. The controller passes `c`. The error fires on any row where a.state == 'done' (or any import row) and the result link renders.
findings.evidence: report.txt rows 131-132 and 199-200; web_client.xml:137 and :143 t-attf-href="/my/workspaces/#{ws.id}/clients/#{client.id}/r/..."; clients.py:421-427 passes c=c only
findings.standard: ISO/IEC 25010 operability; ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks
findings.fix: Replace #{client.id} with #{c.id} on lines 137 and 143. Add an HTTP test that renders /clients/<id> for a client with a done attempt.

findings.issue: The 500 page is plain English ('500: Internal Server Error', title 'Internal Server Error'), dir=ltr, lang missing, with no panel navigation, no Persian explanation and no way back except the browser.
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 3.1.1; ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness; Persian conventions
findings.fix: PAT-4: a website-2 500 template (http_routing 500 override with website_id = website 2) in Persian RTL with 'بازگشت به داشبورد پنل' and the support link.

findings.issue: Template review: the page has no 'دعوت به سنجه' action, even though the wizard already supports ?client=<id> preselect (invites.py:149). Acting on a person (inviting to another assessment) needs a trip to another menu.
findings.evidence: web_client.xml:23-33 actions = ویرایش, بایگانی only; invites.py:149
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks
findings.fix: Make 'دعوت به سنجه' (href /invites/new?fresh=1&client=<c.id>) the primary action in tsp-head__actions, with ویرایش as outline.

findings.issue: Template review: on this page 'کارشناس مسئول' uses a primary 'ذخیره' button inside a card, the handover accept also uses primary, and the head has no primary. The primary action of the page is unclear. The '← شرکت‌کنندگان' arrow points the wrong way.
findings.standard: Project rule one primary action per view; RTL direction
findings.fix: Make the card save buttons outline; make the head 'دعوت به سنجه' primary; use '→'.

findings.issue: Template review: in the assessments table only done rows get a 'نتیجه' link. Open invitations get no link to their invitation page (copy link, QR, reminder), so following up on someone who has not finished means going to the invitations list.
findings.fix: For non-done rows, link the status pill to /invites/<a.id> ('پیوند و یادآوری').

pages.task: Correct a participant's details
pages.summary: Same form as new, but both its back link and its save redirect lead to the broken person page, and the heading does not say whose record is being edited.

findings.issue: Both '← بازگشت' and the save redirect target /clients/110, which returns 500. After every edit the user lands on an error page.
findings.fix: Fix P5-1.

findings.issue: The heading 'ویرایش شرکت‌کننده' and the page title do not include the person's name. In a list workflow the user cannot confirm which record is open (the name is only in the first field, which they may be editing).
findings.fix: In _form(): title 'ویرایش «%s»' % c.name.

findings.issue: No 'انصراف' button; the guardian block shows for an adult or unknown age; the back arrow points the wrong way (same as P4-2, P4-3).

pages.task: Read a student's talent profile before a counselling session and decide the next step
pages.summary: Rich, honest report with a print path, but it leaves the panel shell, its back link goes to the 500 page, it is about 12,000 px long on a phone, the voice flips between 'participant' and 'you', it is unreadable in dark mode, and there is nothing to act on.

findings.issue: 'بازگشت به شرکت‌کننده' (back_url) points to /clients/110, which returns 500. The page's only navigation away is broken.
findings.fix: Fix P5-1.

findings.issue: The report sheet (.ts-doc) stays white in dark mode with light text: the title, lead and dt/dd fall to 1.2-2.0:1.
findings.fix: PAT-1

findings.issue: The page renders outside the panel shell: no panel menu, no tab bar, no panel name. Every other panel page has them, so the counselor loses their place and the IA is inconsistent. The status variant (ts_panel.result_bands) does render in the shell.
findings.evidence: page text: no 'نمای کلی/داشبورد' menu; reports.py:51 request.render('ts_talent.report') vs :53 render_in_shell
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 internal consistency; ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness (where am I)
findings.fix: Render the talent report body inside ts_panel.shell_frame (pass member/menu via render_in_shell with a wrapper template that t-calls the report body). Print CSS already hides the shell.

findings.issue: The full report is about 12,100 px on a 375 px phone (field-by-field bars, four radar blocks, seven interpretation levels, full table, long definitions). A counselor between classes cannot find the key message quickly, and there is no in-page table of contents.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-210 context of use; ISO 9241-112 conciseness
findings.fix: Add a sticky 'در این گزارش' jump list (خلاصه، زمینه‌ها، تفسیر، برنامه‌ها، جدول). Collapse 'جدول کامل' and 'دربارهٔ این سنجه' behind aria-expanded buttons on phone.

findings.issue: The org view mixes voices. The lead says 'برداشت خودِ شرکت‌کننده ... خودِ او', then sections say 'توانایی‌های شما در هر زمینه', 'میانگین کلّی شما', 'ضعیف‌ترین استعداد شما', 'زمینه‌های خودِ شما'. The counselor is addressed as if they were the student.
findings.fix: In the engine text helpers, when org_view is set use third person ('توانایی‌های او', 'میانگین کلّی این دانش‌آموز'), and «تو» for the student's own view.

findings.issue: With all fields tied, the text says the same four fields are both 'بالاترین میانگین' and 'پایین‌ترین میانگین', and 'برجسته‌ترین زمینه: ریاضی، هنر، ورزش و زبان'. This is contradictory and invites misreading. The 'with caution' flag repeats on all four fields without a summary.
findings.fix: When max == min, show one sentence: 'میانگین همهٔ زمینه‌ها برابر است؛ ترتیبی میان زمینه‌ها دیده نمی‌شود.' Show one top banner when caution flags cover most fields ('پاسخ‌ها یکسان یا بسیار سریع بود؛ کل گزارش را با احتیاط بخوانید'). Needs a content owner check.

findings.issue: The page has no actions besides print. The counselor cannot assign themselves as responsible, invite to a follow-up assessment, or see who else viewed it, even though the status variant shows viewers.
findings.evidence: page text lines 14-15; reports.py:57 viewers only in result_bands
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks (act on the result)
findings.fix: Add a tsp-noprint action bar: 'دعوت به سنجهٔ دیگر' (/invites/new?client=<id>), 'کارشناس مسئول: … تغییر', and the viewers line for audit:read.

findings.issue: Under 'دربارهٔ این سنجه' the definitions of خلّاقیّت نظری and خلّاقیّت عملی show the same paragraph twice. Some source text has Arabic forms and missing نیم‌فاصله (تحريك، كه، تواناییهای، پنجگانهٔ).
findings.fix: Split the sentence per term in the definitions table; normalise ي/ك and ZWNJ at display time (do not change stored book text if verbatim is required).

pages.task: Open a talent result from an old link
pages.summary: Redirects to /clients/110/r/131 (FINAL differs, expected legacy alias), so it carries all the issues of P7.

findings.issue: Legacy route redirects to the new result URL. This is expected. The redirect is also used by ts_org /a/<id> for education results, so it must stay.
findings.fix: Keep. Point ts_org assignment redirect directly at result_url() to save a hop.

findings.issue: Same broken back link and dark-mode sheet as P7-1 and P7-2.
findings.fix: P5-1, PAT-1

pages.task: Organise students into classes for group invitations and reports
pages.summary: Simple and clear, but the member count of 0 gives no hint of how to add people, and dark mode makes the cards unreadable.

findings.issue: The help text explains what groups do not do, not how to fill them. Members are added only from the participants list (bulk action), which the page does not say or link.
findings.evidence: page text line 36; group detail empty state is the only place that explains it
findings.fix: Help text: 'برای افزودن افراد، در فهرست شرکت‌کنندگان آن‌ها را انتخاب و «افزودن به گروه» را بزنید.' with a link to /clients.

findings.issue: The create form 'گروه تازه' takes a whole card below the list. The 'ساخت گروه' primary competes with nothing, but the page has no visible primary in the header like the other list pages (شرکت‌کنندهٔ جدید, دعوت تازه).
findings.fix: Optional: put a header button 'گروه تازه' that jumps to the form (#new-group), matching the other lists.

findings.issue: The list card is white with light text in dark mode.
findings.fix: PAT-1

pages.task: See a class and invite it to an assessment
pages.summary: The empty state explains the next step, but 'دعوت گروه' is offered for a group with 0 members, two buttons look primary, and archiving has no confirmation.

findings.issue: 'دعوت گروه' is active while the group has 0 members. It leads to the campaign form and lets the user create an empty campaign (seed campaign 1 'دعوت کلاس دهم' has 0 invitations).
findings.evidence: page text lines 36-41; campaigns list row 'دعوت کلاس دهم ۰'
findings.fix: When client_count == 0, replace the button with a link 'افزودن شرکت‌کننده از فهرست' (/clients) and explain that the group invite needs members.

findings.issue: 'دعوت گروه' (head) and 'ذخیره' (rename) are both accent-filled primaries. The empty-state text names the clients list without linking it.
findings.standard: Project rule one primary per view; ISO 9241-112 discriminability
findings.fix: Make rename 'ذخیرهٔ نام' outline. Link «فهرست شرکت‌کنندگان» in the empty state.

findings.issue: 'بایگانی گروه' fires with one click and no confirmation, unlike close-campaign and withdraw-invite, which use a confirm checkbox. 'ردیف‌ها' is database jargon.
findings.fix: Use the same confirm-checkbox pattern ('مطمئنم، این گروه بایگانی شود'). Copy: 'بایگانی گروه، شرکت‌کنندگانش را حذف نمی‌کند.'

pages.task: Follow who opened, started and finished an assessment, and open finished results
pages.summary: Good state chips and a clear primary, but finished rows give no result link, the counts are glued to the chip labels, and dark-mode cards are unreadable.

findings.issue: The list cards are white with light text in dark mode.
findings.fix: PAT-1

findings.issue: A row in state تکمیل‌شده links only to the invitation page; the result is one more click away. This is the main 'follow who finished, open result' path and the target of the dashboard attention item.
findings.fix: Add a cell: when a.state == 'done' and a.attempt_id and result level != none, show a 'نتیجه' link to result_url(ws, a.client_id, a.attempt_id). Bold or mark unseen results (dashboard 'unseen').

findings.issue: The chip counts touch the labels ('همه۲', 'بازشده۱', 'پذیرفته۰'), and the chips overflow off-screen with no cue (منقضی, ردشده, لغوشده hidden).
findings.fix: .tsp-chip { gap: 6px; display:inline-flex } and render the count as a small badge. Wrap the chips on phone or add a fade (PAT-5).

findings.issue: The column 'ارسال' shows the creation time even though nothing was sent ('تلنت سرچ پیامکی نفرستاده است').
findings.fix: Rename to 'ساخته‌شده'. Keep 'ارسال پیامک' only in details.

pages.task: Invite one student to one assessment and get a link/QR
pages.summary: A sound four-step wizard with nothing sent before review, but step 1 forces a search with two competing primary forms, the stepper is clipped on phone, step 3 uses a Gregorian date picker, and there is no cancel.

findings.issue: Step 1 shows two forms with two 'ادامه' primaries ('شرکت‌کنندهٔ موجود' search and 'فرد تازه'). Existing participants are not listed at all until you search, even with 3 people. The 'فرد تازه' form lacks گروه سنی, so minors are only discovered at review (guardian consent).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability; ISO 9241-143 field grouping; project rule one primary
findings.fix: Show the 10 most recent participants as radios under the search (recent first). Make 'فرد تازه' a disclosure ('یا فرد تازه بنویسید') with an outline submit. Add a گروه سنی select (default زیر ۱۸ in education).

findings.issue: Template review: step 3 'مهلت' is <input type=date>. It renders as a Gregorian mm/dd/yyyy picker with English placeholders (same control as campaigns/new).
findings.standard: Persian conventions (Solar Hijri dates); ISO 9241-143 input formats; WCAG 3.1.1
findings.fix: PAT-2: a Jalali date field (three selects روز/ماه/سال with Persian month names, or a text input with format hint ۱۴۰۵/۰۸/۱۵ and server-side parse).

findings.issue: The stepper is clipped ('۴. مرور' cut at the edge) with a hidden scrollbar. The user cannot see the length of the task.
findings.fix: On phone show 'گام ۱ از ۴ · چه کسی' as text instead of the chip row, or let the chips wrap.

findings.issue: There is no 'انصراف' on any step. Steps 2-4 have 'قبلی' as a quiet button placed after the primary, which in RTL reads as the forward position.
findings.fix: Add 'انصراف' (link to /invites, clears the draft with fresh=1). Put 'قبلی' at the end side with a → icon, consistent with PAT-3.

pages.task: Copy or show the link/QR, remind, extend or withdraw one invitation
pages.summary: Clear link plus QR, honest SMS status and a guarded withdraw, but the link to the participant page crashes, and there is no native share for the phone context.

findings.issue: The header link 'صفحهٔ شرکت‌کننده' goes to /clients/<id>, which returns 500.
findings.fix: Fix P5-1.

findings.issue: On a phone the counselor will usually send the link through a messenger. Only 'رونوشت پیوند' exists, with no share action.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-210 context of use; ISO 9241-110 suitability
findings.fix: Add a 'هم‌رسانی' button that calls navigator.share({url}) when available (hidden otherwise), next to the copy button.

findings.issue: 'فرستادن یادآوری' is offered for a guest invitee with no account and no SMS consent. The hint says it only reaches people with an account or SMS consent, so pressing it may do nothing, and the page does not say whether that is the case.
findings.evidence: page text lines 54-58 (channel پیوند, no sms_consent)
findings.fix: When neither a linked user nor sms_consent exists, replace the button with 'یادآوری فقط با پیوند ممکن است؛ پیوند را دوباره بفرستید.'

findings.issue: The withdraw button uses the same outline style as 'تمدید دعوت', with no danger styling.
findings.fix: Use ts-btn--danger-outline (token --status-danger) for destructive submits (PAT-6).

pages.task: View the status of one invitation (legacy assignment page)
pages.summary: A second, older page for the same invitation as /invites/5: outside the panel shell, read-only, uses different terms, and is unreadable in dark mode.

findings.issue: Two pages show the same ts.assignment: /a/5 (legacy, no link/QR/actions, no shell) and /invites/5 (panel v2). Users who reach /a/5 from old links or notifications get a dead end with nothing to do.
findings.evidence: a_5 page text (only dl); invites_5 page text (link, QR, remind, extend, withdraw)
findings.fix: For non-education/none levels, redirect /a/<id> to /invites/<id> for members with invites:manage (keep the ts_org page only for roles without it). The education redirect stays.

findings.issue: The .ts-doc card is white with near-white text in dark mode.
findings.fix: PAT-1

findings.issue: The term 'تخصیص‌نشده' is used for the responsible counselor, while the panel v2 pages use 'بدون کارشناس'. There are two names for one concept.
findings.evidence: a_5 text line 28; clients text 'بدون کارشناس'; ts_org web_org.xml:288, web_member.xml:41,96, members.py:173
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 consistency; project rule one term per concept
findings.fix: Replace 'تخصیص‌نشده' with 'بدون کارشناس' everywhere (ts_org + ts_panel strings).

pages.task: See group invitations and how far each class has got
pages.summary: Clean list with one primary, but it shows no progress (finished of invited), and the section name 'دعوت گروهی' is also the name of one of its two kinds.

findings.issue: The column 'دعوت‌ها' shows only a count. There is no 'تکمیل‌شده N از M', so the counselor cannot see which class still has stragglers without opening each campaign.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability (follow who finished); ISO 9241-112 detectability
findings.fix: Replace 'دعوت‌ها' with 'پیشرفت': '<done> از <total> تکمیل' (+ a thin progress bar with text). For an open link: 'پیوسته <joined> از <open_max>'.

findings.issue: 'دعوت گروهی' names the menu item, the page, the list and one kind ('نوع: دعوت گروهی' vs 'پیوند باز'). The kind column cannot discriminate.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 discriminability; one term per concept
findings.fix: Rename the kinds 'فهرست افراد (کلاس یا گروه)' and 'پیوند باز'. Keep 'دعوت گروهی' as the section name.

findings.issue: The cards are white in dark mode.
findings.fix: PAT-1

pages.task: Invite a whole class, or make an open link/QR for an event
pages.summary: Good review-before-create, but one form mixes the fields of both kinds, shows a Gregorian date picker, lists empty groups as choosable, and does not pre-select the only instrument.

findings.issue: All fields for both kinds show at once ('گروه‌ها (برای دعوت گروهی)', 'سقف پیوستن (برای پیوند باز)', 'اعتبار پیوند باز', 'پیامک (برای دعوت گروهی)'). The user has to work out which fields apply to the choice they made.
findings.fix: Make the kind the first question and show only the matching fieldset (JS toggle of [hidden] on change; no-JS shows both with headings 'فقط برای فهرست افراد' / 'فقط برای پیوند باز').

findings.issue: 'مهلت (اختیاری)' is a native date input showing 'mm/dd/yyyy' (Gregorian, English). The open-link cap '60' uses Latin digits.
findings.standard: Persian conventions (Solar Hijri, Persian digits); ISO 9241-143 input formats
findings.fix: PAT-2 Jalali date field. Show the number as text with inputmode=numeric and accept Persian digits (normalise server-side).

findings.issue: Groups with 0 members can be ticked ('کلاس دهم الف (۰ نفر)'). With a single instrument the radio is not pre-selected, which adds a needless required step.
findings.fix: Disable empty groups with the hint 'بدون عضو'. When len(instruments) == 1, check it by default.

findings.issue: 'یک یادآوری هم فرستاده شود' is pre-checked while SMS itself is off, so its effect is unclear.
findings.fix: Indent it under the SMS checkbox and enable it only when SMS is checked.

pages.task: Follow a class invitation: who finished, who did not, print the sheet
pages.summary: Status counts and a guarded close are present, but the campaign is empty with no guidance, 'برگهٔ چاپی' leads to an empty page, the state counts are non-interactive spans in a nav, and the close button is ambiguous.

findings.issue: The empty state 'هنوز دعوتی در این مجموعه نیست.' gives no reason (the group had 0 members) and no next step. 'برگهٔ چاپی' is still offered and opens a page saying there is nothing to print.
findings.evidence: campaigns_1 text lines 38, 57; sheet text line 40
findings.standard: NN/g empty states; ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness
findings.fix: When kind == list and total == 0: explain 'گروه انتخاب‌شده هنگام ساخت عضوی نداشت' with a link to the group, and hide 'برگهٔ چاپی'.

findings.issue: The eight state counts are <span> chips inside a <nav aria-label>. They look like the clickable filter chips on /invites but do nothing, and the nav landmark holds no links.
findings.fix: Make them links to /invites?campaign=<id>&state=<k>, or use <ul class='tsp-stats'> without the nav role and a non-chip style.

findings.issue: The section title and button 'بستن' read like 'close this panel/dialog'. The destructive outcome (nobody can join, no reminders) needs a specific label.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with expectations; GOV.UK button labels
findings.fix: Heading 'پایان دادن به این دعوت گروهی', button 'پایان دعوت گروهی' with danger-outline style (PAT-6).

findings.issue: The empty-state box (.tsp-empty) is white with light text in dark mode.
findings.fix: PAT-1

pages.task: Show or print the open link/QR at an event and watch joins
pages.summary: The link, QR, cap and expiry are clear on phone, but there is no share or full-screen QR for projecting, 'مجموعه' is a new term, and the close action is ambiguous.

findings.issue: At an exhibition the counselor shows the QR from the phone, but it is only 200 px inside a card, with no full-screen view and no share button.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-210 context of use; ISO 9241-110 suitability
findings.fix: Wrap the QR in a link to /campaigns/<id>/sheet ('نمایش بزرگ برای اسکن'), and add navigator.share next to 'رونوشت پیوند'.

findings.issue: For an open link, 'هنوز دعوتی در این مجموعه نیست' introduces 'مجموعه' and does not match 'پیوسته‌اند ۰ از ۶۰'.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 consistency; one term per concept
findings.fix: For an open link: 'هنوز کسی با این پیوند نپیوسته است.' For a list: 'هنوز دعوتی در این دعوت گروهی ساخته نشده است.'

findings.issue: The same ambiguous 'بستن' destructive action as P17-3, and the same non-interactive count chips as P17-2.
The empty-state box is white in dark mode (the QR keeping a white backing is correct).
findings.fix: PAT-1 (keep .tsp-qr #fff).

pages.task: Print per-student links/QR codes to hand out in class
pages.summary: For this list campaign the sheet is a dead end: an unclear message ('دعوت بازی برای چاپ نیست'), no print button, and an unclear 'برگشت' label.

findings.issue: 'دعوت بازی برای چاپ نیست.' is ambiguous: 'باز' reads as 'open link', and the cause (no invitations exist) is not stated. The page should not have been reachable (P17-1).
findings.fix: Copy: 'این دعوت گروهی هنوز دعوتی ندارد که چاپ شود. ابتدا افراد را به گروه اضافه کنید.' with a link to the group.

findings.issue: Template review: the page says 'برای چاپ از منوی مرورگر استفاده کنید'. There is no print button, and on phones the browser menu print is hard to find.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability; ISO 9241-210 context of use
findings.fix: Add a tsp-noprint 'چاپ برگه' button (onclick=window.print()) as the single primary. Keep the hint for no-JS.

findings.issue: 'برگشت' (quiet) has no target name, and the panel uses بازگشت/برگشت/همهٔ… inconsistently for back links.
findings.fix: PAT-3: '→ دعوت کلاس دهم'.

pages.task: Choose a panel to work in (or create one)
pages.summary: Works, but it calls panels 'فضای کاری' while the rest of the product says 'پنل', it uses a different type label from the create form, the invitation summary is garbled, and creating a panel outranks entering one.

findings.issue: The page is titled 'فضاهای کاری' with 'ورود به فضا' and 'هر فضا…', while the header button, the switch link 'تغییر پنل', the create form and the whole shell say 'پنل'. Two terms for the main object of the product.
findings.evidence: workspaces text lines 14-29; web_org.xml:20,25,43; web_panel.xml:97 back link 'فضاهای کاری'
findings.fix: 'پنل‌های من', 'هر پنل فقط یک هدف دارد و داده‌ها هرگز بین پنل‌ها جابه‌جا نمی‌شوند.', button 'ورود به پنل', back link '→ پنل‌های من'.

findings.issue: The type badge says 'دانشگاه و مدرسه', but the create form's option is 'مدرسه یا مرکز مشاوره'.
findings.evidence: workspaces text line 20; workspaces_new text line 18
findings.fix: Use one label from a shared PURPOSE_LABELS dict.

findings.issue: 'دعوت‌ها ۱ · تکمیل‌شده ۱' reads as a bare number run, and it disagrees with the panel's own count (۲ دعوت). It also shows nothing that needs attention.
findings.evidence: workspaces text lines 27-28; dashboard '۲ دعوت‌های فرستاده‌شده'
findings.fix: Show '۲ دعوت · ۱ تکمیل‌شده' from the same query as the dashboard, plus 'N نتیجهٔ تازه' when unseen > 0.

findings.issue: 'ساخت پنل تازه' (accent fill) sits above the existing panel, and 'ورود به فضا' is a small button at the card's end. The frequent task (enter my panel) is visually weaker than the rare one.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability; project rule one primary per view
findings.fix: Make the whole card a link with a primary 'ورود به پنل'. Move 'ساخت پنل تازه' below the list as outline.

findings.issue: The inner dl box is white with light text in dark mode.
findings.fix: PAT-1 (ts_org org.scss uses var(--white) too).

pages.task: Create another panel
pages.summary: Short form, but every conditional field shows for every type, the approval note comes after the button, and an English screen-reader string leaks into the terms link.

findings.issue: Fields that apply only to some types always show: 'اگر پنل یک‌نفره است…', '(فقط روان‌شناس…) شمارهٔ پروانه', '(فقط پنل بالینی) می‌پذیرم…'. A school owner reads and skips three irrelevant controls.
findings.fix: Reveal each dependent field only after its radio is chosen (JS toggling [hidden]; no-JS fallback keeps the '(فقط …)' prefixes).

findings.issue: The screen-reader text '(Open in new tab)' is appended to the 'شرایط استفاده' link (Odoo adds it for target=_blank). This is English in a Persian UI.
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 3.1.2; Persian rules (no English UI words)
findings.fix: Drop target=_blank (open the terms in the same tab, since the form keeps its values), or add a Persian sr-only '(در زبانهٔ تازه)' and exclude the link from Odoo's auto label.

findings.issue: The note that organisation/clinic panels start restricted until approval appears only after the submit button, so the user learns it after deciding.
findings.fix: Put the note as a hint under the 'نوع پنل' legend, or next to each gated option ('نیاز به تأیید').

findings.issue: The 'نوع پنل' legend is styled as a large heading while the other labels are small bold. The radios are native about 13 px controls (the label is clickable, so 2.5.8 passes, but they are visually tiny).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-125 hierarchy; project 44 px target rule
findings.fix: Style the legend like .tsp-field__label. Use the tsp-radio pattern (44 px rows) from the panel forms.

patterns.issue: Dark mode: every surface painted with var(--white) (.tsp-stat, .tsp-table, .ts-table-wrap, .tsp-table--cards tr, .tsp-empty, .ts-doc, ts_org org.scss boxes) stays white while text switches to light. KPI tiles, all list cards, empty states, the result report and the assignment page fall to 1.2-2.0:1. Tokens.scss maps --white only in the light :root block. Some other bundle (likely Odoo or Bootstrap's own --white: #fff) wins in dark; this is inferred, the pattern is verified in the shots.
patterns.fix: In ts_website tokens.scss add '--white: var(--color-surface);' inside :root[data-theme="dark"] (and in light :root keep it). Better, replace var(--white) with var(--color-surface) in panel.scss (lines 109,117,144,145,155,159), assessment.scss:79 and org.scss:10,19,23. Keep .tsp-qr at #fff. Re-run the dark shots and the report's contrast check.

patterns.issue: Native <input type=date> renders a Gregorian mm/dd/yyyy picker with English placeholders for every deadline field.
patterns.fix: One shared QWeb macro ts_panel.jalali_date (روز/ماه/سال selects with Persian month names, or a text field with hint ۱۴۰۵/۰۸/۱۵ and server-side Jalali parse via the existing jalali helpers). Use it in both forms and in the review pages.

patterns.issue: Back links point the wrong way and are worded differently: '← بازگشت' and '← شرکت‌کنندگان' (left arrow = forward in RTL), against '→ پنل آزمایشی آموزشی' and '→ فضاهای کاری' in ts_org, plus unlabeled 'برگشت', 'همهٔ دعوت‌ها' and 'همهٔ دعوت‌های گروهی' buttons. Placement also varies: above the heading, or as a header button.
patterns.fix: A shell parameter back_url/back_label rendered by ts_panel.shell_frame above the h1 as '→ {parent name}' (ts_website.icon arrow-right). Remove the ad-hoc '←' links and the 'همهٔ …' header buttons.

patterns.issue: Server errors on website 2 show Odoo's English '500: Internal Server Error' page (dir=ltr, no lang, no navigation).
patterns.fix: A website-2 500 template like the existing Persian 404 (CLAUDE.md pitfalls): Persian RTL, 'خطایی پیش آمد؛ دوباره تلاش کنید', links to the panel dashboard and support, and an error reference code.

patterns.issue: On phones, chip rows (filters, status counts, wizard steps) overflow with hidden scrollbars and no fade. Off-screen options are undiscoverable, and counts touch their labels.
patterns.fix: panel.scss:171/176: let chips wrap (flex-wrap: wrap) under 768 px, or keep the scroll and add mask-image: linear-gradient(to left, transparent, #000 24px) at the end edge. .tsp-chip { display:inline-flex; gap:6px } with the count as a small badge. Show 'گام N از ۴' as text instead of step chips on phone.

patterns.issue: Destructive actions (لغو دعوت, بستن دعوت گروهی, بایگانی گروه/شرکت‌کننده) use neutral outline/quiet styles and inconsistent confirmation: some have a confirm checkbox, archive has none.
patterns.fix: One .ts-btn--danger-outline (border/text --status-danger) and the same 'مطمئنم، …' checkbox pattern for every destructive submit, with labels that name the object ('لغو این دعوت', 'پایان دعوت گروهی', 'بایگانی گروه').

patterns.issue: IA: the counselor's core loop (participant -> invite -> follow -> result -> act) has no direct links between its objects. Lists lack result and invite actions, the person page lacks 'دعوت به سنجه', the result page leaves the shell and offers no actions, legacy pages (/a/<id>, 'دعوت و فهرست (نسخهٔ قبلی)') duplicate v2 pages, and notifications (notify.py:243,250,360,407) all target the person page that currently 500s.
patterns.fix: Fix P5-1 first (one-line template fix). Then make the person page the hub: primary 'دعوت به سنجه' (/invites/new?client=), each assessment row links to its invite or result. Add 'نتیجه' cells on the invites/clients lists, render the talent report inside the shell with an action bar, and redirect legacy /a/<id> to /invites/<id> for invite managers (owner decision).

patterns.issue: The sidebar group headings (span.tsp-nav__group, about 12 px) measure 4.0:1 in light mode, below 4.5:1. The group 'شرکت‌کنندگان' repeats the item 'شرکت‌کنندگان' directly under it. At 375 the checker reports unnamed a.tsp-switch__link/a.tsp-nav__item, probably because the drawer is visibility:hidden when measured. Verify with the drawer open.
patterns.fix: Use color var(--color-neutral-400) (not 500/600) for .tsp-nav__group, or raise it to 13 px semibold. Rename the group to 'افراد و دعوت' to avoid the duplicate. Re-check the unnamed-link report with the drawer opened.

patterns.issue: Terminology drift across G3: پنل/فضای کاری, بدون کارشناس/تخصیص‌نشده, دعوت گروهی (section) / دعوت گروهی (kind), ارسال (for links nothing sent), مجموعه, and ردیف (database jargon in user copy).
patterns.fix: Add these to the glossary and replace them: پنل, بدون کارشناس, فهرست افراد / پیوند باز (kinds), ساخته‌شده, شرکت‌کننده (instead of ردیف).
